answer: The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. Hand the panel a tide it can verify, a crystal it can count, and a quill it can date, and the panel will do the rest. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Penman charter page proof lettered across the inkwell bench: the toll is each charter page is a sheet record witnessed by the inspector, paid in the open. The fine for one forgery is 2 times the stake, so a 80 POA proof becomes a 2x loss when the panel finds it.
